preconditions.description: The number of sentences T must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: len(M) == 26 and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in M)
preconditions.description: M must be a permutation of the lowercase English alphabet.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100 for S in sentences)
preconditions.description: Each sentence must be non-empty and contain at most 100 characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == ''.join(translate_sentence(S, M) for S in sentences)
postconditions.description: The output must be the English translation of each Bytelandian sentence.

postconditions.expression: all(' ' in translated for translated in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each translated sentence must have underscores replaced with spaces.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.,!? ' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output must only contain valid characters including lowercase and uppercase letters, punctuation, and spaces.
